_comment: Text and figures specific to the research map (static/research-map/): the beam narration, labels, figures and toy links. Everything else is added at build time by layouts/partials/zl_research_map_data.html: statement and description from the home page hero; question, method, finding and status from research.json; papers from the publication pages; verbs and colours from stations.json; cases from cases.json.

stations.name: 無標記非線性光學顯微
stations.beam: 780 nm 的近紅外光聚在樣品上一點，組織自己發出兩種新的光：膠原蛋白發出波長減半的 390 nm 二倍頻光（SHG），細胞分子發出雙光子螢光。二向色鏡把兩種光分開，各進一顆偵測器。

figure.alt: 論文圖包含 H&E 組織切片，以及食道組織的 SHG、雙光子螢光與合併影像。
figure.caption: 2025 年食道研究圖 2：H&E 染色切片，以及 SHG、雙光子螢光與合併影像。這項研究用的是含 H&E 染色的病理切片，所以這張圖不能當成「完全不染色」的示範。
figure.credit: Makkithaya et al. · Scientific Reports · Fig. 2

toys.desc: 打開雷射掃描顯微鏡，跟著光走到偵測器。

toys.title: 共軛焦 Pinhole 模擬

toys.title: 脈衝串 ↔ 頻率梳
toys.desc: 脈衝雷射為什麼是一支頻率梳，和壽命量測有什麼關係。

stations.name: 膠原蛋白手性與細胞外基質定量
stations.beam: 半波片把入射光的偏振方向一格一格轉過去。膠原纖維和偏振方向平行時 SHG 最亮，所以從亮度隨角度怎麼變，就能讀出纖維的排列。

figure.alt: 退化性關節炎軟骨的 H&E、SHG 強度、感受率比值、偏振與方向分布圖。
figure.caption: 2024 年軟骨研究圖 3：退化性關節炎軟骨的 H&E 切片、SHG 強度與偏振參數圖，保留完整圖。
figure.credit: Makkithaya et al. · APL Bioengineering · Fig. 3

toys.title: SHG 互動教室
toys.desc: 倍頻訊號從哪來、為什麼膠原特別亮。

toys.title: P-SHG 偏振遊樂場
toys.desc: 轉偏振、看花瓣圖，讀出纖維方向。

toys.title: P-SHG 影像實驗室
toys.desc: 從一疊偏振影像，逐像素算出纖維方向圖。

stations.name: AI 輔助無標記病理
stations.beam: 光到這裡已經變成數字。偵測器的訊號經資料線進工作站，組成一張張影像；再從影像裡算出紋理特徵，交給分類器判斷。

figure.alt: 四張 ROC 曲線圖，各自比較兩個食道組織診斷組別的 SVM 分類結果。
figure.caption: 2025 年食道研究圖 8：以 SHG 影像紋理特徵訓練的 SVM 分類器，在四組兩兩比較下的 ROC 曲線，保留完整圖。
figure.credit: Makkithaya et al. · Scientific Reports · Fig. 8

toys.title: GLCM 紋理分類遊樂場
toys.desc: 把組織紋理變成數字，再讓 SVM 畫分界線（合成影像）。

toys.title: 反卷積互動實驗台
toys.desc: 分析之前：模糊、光子雜訊，影像能救回多少。

stations.name: 微型化非線性內視顯微術
stations.beam: 光不再走桌上的鏡子，改進光纖送到手持探頭，訊號再沿光纖收回來。飛秒脈衝在光纖裡會被拉寬，所以送進去之前要先補償。

figure.alt: 3D 示意圖：橘色光纖接到一支手持探頭，探頭指向培養皿裡的組織樣品。
figure.caption: 概念示意：光纖把激發光送到手持探頭。這是本頁 3D 場景的渲染圖，不是實驗室的實機照片。

toys.title: 光纖脈衝變寬遊樂場
toys.desc: 飛秒脈衝為什麼在光纖裡變寬，預補償怎麼拉回來。

stations.name: Label-free nonlinear optical microscopy
stations.beam: The 780 nm near-infrared beam is focused to one point on the sample, and the tissue itself emits two new kinds of light: collagen gives second-harmonic generation (SHG) at half the wavelength, 390 nm, and molecules in cells give two-photon fluorescence. A dichroic mirror separates the two, each into its own detector.

figure.alt: Published figure with H&E histology and SHG, two-photon fluorescence and merged esophageal tissue images.
figure.caption: Fig. 2 of the 2025 esophageal study: H&E-stained sections alongside SHG, two-photon fluorescence and merged images. The study uses pathology sections that include H&E staining, so this figure is not a demonstration of entirely stain-free imaging.
figure.credit: Makkithaya et al. · Scientific Reports · Fig. 2

toys.title: FLIM phasor playground
toys.desc: How fluorescence lifetimes become a phasor plot.

toys.title: CARS beat playground
toys.desc: How two beating lasers read out molecular vibrations.

toys.title: FV300 3D microscope
toys.desc: Open up a laser-scanning microscope and follow the light to the detectors.

toys.title: Confocal pinhole simulator
toys.desc: Trade optical-section thickness against collected light.

toys.title: Pulse train ↔ frequency comb
toys.desc: Why a pulsed laser is a comb of frequencies, and what that means for lifetime detection.

stations.name: Collagen chirality and extracellular-matrix quantification
stations.beam: A half-wave plate rotates the polarization of the incoming light step by step. SHG is brightest when collagen fibers lie parallel to the polarization, so how the brightness changes with angle reveals how the fibers are arranged.

figure.alt: Osteoarthritis cartilage: H&E images, SHG intensity, susceptibility ratio, polarization and orientation maps.
figure.caption: Fig. 3 of the 2024 cartilage study: H&E sections, SHG intensity and polarization-derived maps of osteoarthritic cartilage. Full figure retained.
figure.credit: Makkithaya et al. · APL Bioengineering · Fig. 3

toys.title: SHG academy
toys.desc: Where the frequency-doubled signal comes from, and why collagen is bright.

toys.title: P-SHG polarization playground
toys.desc: Rotate the polarization and read fiber orientation from the polar plot.

toys.title: P-SHG image lab
toys.desc: From a stack of polarization images to pixel-by-pixel fiber-orientation maps.

stations.name: AI-assisted label-free pathology
stations.beam: By this station the light has become numbers. Detector signals travel by cable to the workstation and are assembled into images; texture features are then computed from the images and handed to a classifier.

figure.alt: Four ROC curves, each comparing SVM classification of two diagnostic groups of esophageal tissue.
figure.caption: Fig. 8 of the 2025 esophageal study: ROC curves of an SVM classifier trained on SHG image texture features, for four pairwise comparisons. Full figure retained.
figure.credit: Makkithaya et al. · Scientific Reports · Fig. 8

toys.title: GLCM texture classification playground
toys.desc: Turn tissue texture into numbers, then let a linear SVM draw the line (synthetic images).

toys.title: Deconvolution playground
toys.desc: Before analysis: blur, photon noise, and how far an image can be restored.

stations.name: Miniaturized nonlinear endomicroscopy
stations.beam: Instead of mirrors on the bench, the light enters an optical fiber to a handheld probe, and the signal returns along the fiber. Femtosecond pulses stretch inside fiber, so they must be pre-compensated before going in.

figure.alt: 3D illustration: an orange optical fiber leads to a handheld probe pointed at tissue in a Petri dish.
figure.caption: Concept illustration: an optical fiber delivers excitation light to a handheld probe. Rendered from this page's 3D scene; not a photograph of a lab instrument.

toys.title: Fiber pulse-broadening playground
toys.desc: Why a femtosecond pulse stretches in fiber, and how pre-compensation pulls it back.
